result.summary: The page is mostly well-designed, but one restaurant card shows a broken delivery fee value ('€NaN delivery'), indicating a data/formatting bug. Other elements (partially visible carousel item and bottom-cut card) are expected behavior and not reported.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card displays '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid delivery price, indicating a failed number parse or missing data rendered as NaN.
issues.suggestion: Fix the data pipeline or formatting logic so the delivery fee renders a valid amount (e.g. '€0.90 delivery' or 'Free delivery'); add a fallback for missing/invalid values instead of showing NaN.
